hooks.name: Auto Commit & Push on File Save
hooks.description: Automatically stages, commits, and pushes source file changes to GitHub so Vercel rebuilds.

action.command: cd /d "c:\Users\mutua\cryptcoin" && "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe" add -A && "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe" diff --cached --quiet || "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe" commit -m "auto: update" && "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe" push origin master
